STEP 4 - Area: squash ~12%, tuna salad ~20%, carrot ~25%, avocado ~5%. Total ≈ 62% of the plate is covered by food, which fits what is visible.

- Squash: 64 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 127 ml
- Tuna salad: 106 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 212 ml

- Tuna salad: 212 × 0.9 ≈ 191 g

STEP 7 - Energy:

- Tuna salad: 191 g × 150 kcal/100 g ≈ 287 kcal
- Carrot: 120 g × 40 kcal/100 g ≈ 48 kcal
- Avocado: 24 g × 160 kcal/100 g ≈ 38 kcal
- Total ≈ 407 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 410 g on a 26 cm plate that is roughly 60% covered is plausible. The tuna salad is the densest, energy-heavy component, so most of the calories come from it.
